title: CE61004: Track Engineering
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Objectives: This course aims to provide an in-depth understanding of railway
track engineering concepts including track component and system design,
construction, evaluation, maintenance, load distribution, wheel–rail
interaction, track layout and geometry. Credit: {(3-1-0) 4 credits}Syllabus:
Introduction; Wheel-Rail interface; Curves and Gradients; Track Loads; Static
Track Design; Dynamic Track Design; Track Stability; Ballasted Track; Slab
Track; Switches and Crossings; High Speed Tracks; Track Maintenance, Testing
and Acceptance; Inspection and Detection SystemsTeachers: Profs. K. S. Reddy,
M. Amarnath Reddy, K. P. Biligiri, Sujit Dash, Nirjhar Dhang, Arghya
DebReferences: Railway Track Engineering, J. S. Mundrey, Tata-McGraw Hill
Indian Railways Permanent Way Manual, Government of India,
Ministry of Railways
Modern Railway Track, Coenraad
Esveld, MRT Productions
Railroad Engineering, William F.
Hay, John Wiley
